_doc: Partnership / Cease & Desist: the storm verse set (Fendi, 14 Nov 2026: at 'Yo yo yo yo' he lets off a war cry; 'the yell turns into hurricane-force winds and the picture cuts to him standing centre screen, rapping the verse, while memories and material objects blow past him: silhouettes of pictures of him and his friend, cars, debris, holograms of memories. It's as if I'm trying to hold on to the memories of my friend.'). Fendi, 16 Nov: build the scene now so it sets how he shoots; timing waits for his footage. Units: metres. World: the camera's foot is (0,0,0), +Y away from the camera, +X screen right, +Z up. Every value is MEASURED, SPEC, ESTIMATE or DECISION.

camera._height: DECISION: phone at his chest height, level (pitch 0); with the lens below the frame runs from his knees to 0.35 m above his head (build skill: knees up or full body, locked off)
camera._focal: ESTIMATE: an iPhone at 2x (48 mm equivalent, diagonal field 48.5 deg): 1101.5 px half-diagonal / tan(24.2 deg); the same on 1920x1080 (16:9) as on 1080x1920
camera._distance: DECISION: 2.5 m from lens to him leaves room for debris to pass between camera and him; at 2.5 m the frame is 1.96 m tall at his plane

him._face: DECISION: debris passing IN FRONT of him never crosses this box (x0, x1, z0, z1 at his plane), so his real mouth stays readable on every lyric
him._body: DECISION: debris passing his plane stays this far from his centre line (shoulders, arms, clothes in the wind) or goes over his head

key_light._doc: DECISION: one big soft cool key from camera-left (his right), 45 deg round and 30 deg up, like a bright overcast break in the storm; he lights himself the same way on set (shooting sheet). The far side of his face falls off one stop: storm light, not a flat front light

fill._doc: DECISION: a weak cool fill from camera-right so the dark side keeps detail

lightning._doc: DECISION: flashes in the clouds behind him only (the sky and far debris flash); they do NOT light him, so his take never has to match a flash. A rim flash on him is a finishing choice later

wind._doc: strength over the shot: base + sum a*sin(2*pi*t/period + phase); every object, the dust and the rain ride the same curve
wind._direction: Fendi, 16 Nov: 'I wanted the debris coming from the direction of the camera going past me' / 'Front to back'. The storm blows from behind the camera, past him, away into the distance; on set the fan is beside the camera, out of frame, blowing straight at him

debris._doc: Stand-ins until his photographs of the two of them are supplied: 'frames' are picture frames (later his photos of them, as silhouettes), 'holograms' glow (later memory pictures), 'cars' tumble far behind him (generic shapes; never a white Challenger: project notes), chunks and papers are storm debris. Lanes: start region (m, camera at 0) and depth speed (m/s at base wind). max_screen_frac: no object near the lens is wider than this share of the frame

front._doc: DECISION: starts behind or just past the lens, comes into the picture large, rushes past him

side._doc: DECISION: comes in from beside the camera, past his sides, away

holo._doc: DECISION: memories drift slower than the debris

far._doc: DECISION: cars tumble off into the storm well behind him

end._doc: where each path is aimed, as a fraction of the half frame at its end depth

debris._min_screen_travel: DECISION (preview v1 → v2 check, 16 Nov: a frame hung still by his hip for half a second, receding along its own line of sight): every object crosses at least this many half-frame widths on screen while in the picture

render._frames: DECISION: a 6 s preview; the verse length comes from the master once his footage is in
render._size: DECISION by Fendi, 16 Nov 2026: 16:9 is the master ('I want to actually post this one on YouTube and run it as a single'); a 9:16 cut comes second
